head: TELL ME ABOUT
<g>YOURSELF</g>
MADE SIMPLE.
hacks: Recruiters want to know your current focus before hearing past details.
Start with your current uni degree and key modules.
Sharing relevant past work proves your skills quickly.
Mention one society role and one work placement.
Connect your past to this role.
Showing relevance explains why you applied for this position.
Say: "This led me to build skills in project planning."
Finishing with your vision shows clear motivation.
Explain why this graduate scheme fits your next step.
Keep the pitch under two minutes.
Long answers can cause interviewers to lose focus early.
Practise your answer out loud using a timer.
out: Send it to a friend prepping
